reason: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and those last longer. The sachet is handy since I forget things at home, but I would not pay this much for one mineral when I already skip my counter vitamins half the time.
objection: It costs more than the gummies I already know, and I am not sure I would actually take it every evening for 30 days.
would_change_my_mind: A first box at about $19 to $20, so I can try it without feeling I overpaid.
